question: #25: can a shared four-symbol child code profit from final-face rather than greedy training?
geometry: Periodic 20^3 cold archive; 1000 even (x,y,z) origins per parent. Visible 0..3 on all axes, 8 ordered 2^3 children at offsets in {0,2}^3. Final 2x2 microscopic ternary face at x=6,y,z=1,2 (x=4,5 unseen). Greedy child objective: +x face at x=3,y,z=0,1 relative to a 2^3 child (one unseen layer); all even origins once per fit parent. No chosen direction from prior scores.
population: Historic native TRAIN order only, cold positions fit[:256], [:1024], [:4096]; same dev [4096:4608]; locked audit [4608:5120] accessible only with release. Each parent owns all its anchors. No other split, old pooled tables/maps or simulations. Labels are 81 possible ternary faces.
arms: Fit child by hard four-symbol supervised face quantization on own target; top sees 8 actual shared hard symbols (65536 possible tuples) and emits 4 hard symbols. Frozen and joint start from identical fit and all data. Same top hard decoder refits. Joint additionally follows explicit finite-difference child reassignment derivatives through its hard top lookup; any candidate must improve the actual fit score. Direct 4^3 reference: hard supervised additive raw child-word readout with shrinkage to site effects; no child information bottleneck. All hard decoders fit on same fit parents with half-count smoothing; held-apart score is nats per face over a frozen fit marginal. Monitor train/dev hard scores, occupancies, child changes, child derivative, timing and parent scatter.
schedule: All rungs have 1000 equal anchors/parent. Seeds 251,252,253 paired at every rung. 1,2,4 full-fit sweeps after the shared initialization plus one capped 8-sweep checkpoint if either hierarchy arm's largest-rung seed-mean dev score improves by at least 0.0001 nat/face from 2 to 4. No picking favorable audit checkpoint or seed. Small-rung wall timing and raw dev pilot first; if weak extend raw numeric support on fit/dev, labeled as a diagnostic. Local single-thread; cap 3 CPU hours and discovery cutoff, whichever comes first.
endpoints: Primary seed-mean paired joint-minus-frozen per-parent mean at largest rung's scheduled final checkpoint; report all seeds/rungs/checkpoints. Fixed direct raw must have positive dev and audit lower 95% bound over fit marginal for depth interpretation. Practical threshold 0.001 nat/face. Report parent-clustered paired interval, and 80%-power approximate MDE (2.8*SE); if archive chain/seed repeats, cluster accordingly. A null excludes no other architecture/global optimum. A falling dev curve despite rising train is overfit, not a compute plateau certificate. No audit tuning.
